name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Earth goes with Botanist if and only if Engineer does not go with Rios.
Exactly two of these are true: Eklund goes with Captain; Fontaine goes with Earth; Rios goes with Engineer.
Either Europa goes with Botanist or Bauer goes with Engineer.
Either Botanist goes with Eklund or Luna goes with Rios.
Between Botanist and Navigator, one goes with Europa and the other with Luna.

hints.text: Suppose Navigator went with Titan — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Navigator goes with Titan.
Navigator goes with Titan, so it can't also go with Europa.
Navigator goes with Titan, so it can't also go with Luna.
…but now the clue “Between Botanist and Navigator, one goes with Europa and the other with Luna” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Navigator does not go with Titan.
